title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings view and edit permissions could…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with System Settings view and edit permissions can cause the platform to send a stored directory service account bind password to an attacker-controlled host during an LDAP authentication test. This occurs because the system reuses stored credentials when testing authentication against different directory service destinations.
